exposure: Timing of pregnancy in relation to Takayasu arteritis diagnosis
Pregnancies concomitant with or after TAK diagnosis
Disease activity of TAK (National Institutes of Health score)
outcome: Obstetric complications (preeclampsia/eclampsia, premature delivery, intrauterine fetal growth restriction or death)
finding: Takayasu arteritis negatively affects pregnancy outcomes, with pregnancies during or after diagnosis having a higher rate of complications, and disease activity and smoking increasing the risk.
